name: storage_app
label: SciTeX Storage
subtitle: Project data management: browse, upload, download, move, delete
about: Project-scoped data management inside your active SciTeX project. Browse files and folders, and create, upload, download, rename, move, and delete them — all scoped to the project you are working in, with fail-closed path containment and typed errors. Development-only (wip): not exposed in the public App Store until daily internal use is stable. The fleet disk-usage scan remains available at the scan view.
description: SciTeX Storage is a project-scoped data-management app. It surfaces the active project's files and folders through a project file API (list, read, download, write, rename/move, delete, mkdir) built on the scitex_app SDK file primitives. Every operation is scoped to the requester's current project (via the hub's get_current_project + can_view), containment-checked so paths cannot escape the project root, and returns typed errors rather than bare 500s. It is intentionally WIP/internal (wip=true) and stays out of the public App Store until dogfood is stable. The earlier read-only fleet disk-usage scan is preserved at the scan view.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Browse the active project's files and folders (list)
Read + download project files (text + binary-safe attachment)
Create, upload, rename/move, and delete project files and folders
Fail-closed path containment; typed errors, never a bare 500
